calls.title: GrowthBook x EQT IT Sec Team
calls.summary: The discussion focused on the current security setup for endpoint management and the ongoing compliance strategy. Without a formal mobile device management program, the company manages laptops via audits, ensuring they meet requirements for encryption, antivirus protection, and password policies. Data security relies on a cloud architecture, minimizing local data storage risks. Multi-factor authentication and rigorous code reviews are crucial for maintaining data integrity. Self-hosting further enhances client control over data security while continuous audits help monitor compliance with SOC2 requirements. Future plans include scaling management processes as the team grows, with a focus on enhancing security capabilities.
calls.keywords: mobile device management, endpoint security, cloud-based architecture, device encryption, self-hosting, vendor security assessment
